definition.title: Sew Cool Kids - Hand Sewing
definition.description:
Would you like to learn how to hand sew?  Come learn the basics while making your own stuffed monster.  This program requires the participants to have some manual dexterity and be able to understand and follow instructions.  When registering for this program, you will be registering for all the dates in this session.  July 26th, August 9th, 16th and 23rd.

For Ages 7-12.

Please note: This session is a repeat of the hand sewing previously taught here at Elmbrook.

definition.title: Housing Help
definition.description:
Drop in and work one-on-one with staff from The Housing Help Centre (THHC) to determine your housing needs, connect you to other government services, and to match you with landlords across the city. THHC works with both individuals and families in the City of Toronto to find and maintain affordable, safe housing.

THHC can be contacted at 416-285-8070.

definition.title: Puppet Show: Goldilocks and the Three Bears
definition.description:
Join us for a puppet show adaptation of the classic English fairy tale, Goldilocks and the Three Bears (additional songs and stories too!).

For children of all ages with their parents or caregivers. Drop-in, no registration required. Space is limited.

definition.title: Underwater flashlight craft
definition.description:
Join us for a fun-filled activity for kids to try. This underwater flashlight craft is not only fun to make – but also fun to play with!

Participants will use the flashlight to reveal the sea creatures under the sea.

All materials will be provided.

Drop In. No Registration Required, space is limited.

registrationInfo.onlineInstructions: Reading the book prior to attendance is recommended. Links to the TPL copies of the books can be in the event listing.

definition.description:
The Culture and Technology Book club brings readers together once a month to discuss new and classic texts that raise important questions about the way technology transforms our cultural and political lives.

This month we read:

End Times: elites, counter-elites, and the path of political disintegration by Peter Turchin (2023)

Peter Turchin, co-founder of cliodynamics, a new interdisciplinary science of history, uses his novel method of analysis to provide a big-picture explanation for the global situation and predictions for what is to come.
